marketing_headings.usage: Landing page hero, section headers. Use 'tracking-tight' for large sizes.

dashboard_headings.usage: Dashboard module titles, stat card numbers, table headers.

body.usage: All data tables, form inputs, body text, ledgers, and invoice details. Optimized for dense data.

typography.instructions: Import all fonts via Google Fonts in index.css. Never use Inter or default generic sans-serif for headings.

primary.description: Deep Forest Green for primary actions, sidebar active states, and marketing CTAs.

secondary.description: Terracotta/Clay for secondary accents, warnings, or 'Credit' (ઉધાર) tags.

accent.description: Warm Ochre for highlights, 'Cash' (રોકડા) tags, or pending statuses.

surfaces.marketing_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (#E5E7EB), shadow-lg on hover.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Solid white (#FFFFFF), strict 1px border, 0px radius (sharp) or max 4px radius. No shadow for static cards.
surfaces.glassmorphism: Use only for floating marketing nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-black/5.

marketing.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 to py-32 for sections. Container px-6 md:px-12.
marketing.grid: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A) for features. Asymmetric spans (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).

dashboard.structure: Collapsible left-sidebar (fixed width ~260px) + main content area.
dashboard.spacing: Dense. Use p-4 to p-6 for containers. Gap-4 for grids.
dashboard.grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). Top row: 3-4 summary metric cards. Below: Data tables taking full width.

components.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. For Purchase/Sell, use grid layouts for line items (Lot No., Vehicle No., Bag, Weight) to maximize horizontal space.
components.tables: Dense rows. Text sizes text-sm. Use sticky headers. Action buttons inside tables should be ghost or outline icons.
components.invoice: Clean, monochrome print-friendly layout inside a card. Include a prominent 'Download PDF' button.
components.badges: Use rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-xs for Statuses (Cash/Credit, Stock In/Out).
components.navigation: Marketing page must have a sticky nav (backdrop-blur). Dashboard uses a persistent left sidebar.

motion.hover: All interactive elements MUST have a hover state altering background color or opacity. e.g., hover:bg-gray-50.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out. Do not use 'transition-all' globally.
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for table rows or dashboard cards on mount.

accessibility.contrast: Text over hero images must use text-shadow or a gradient overlay (bg-black/40) for readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit').

image_urls.description: Expansive green potato fields under cloudy skies. Ensure bg-black/40 overlay so text pops.
Farmer holding bunch of potatoes. Use in Bento grid or feature section.
Warehouse worker operating a pallet jack. Represents Godown/Cold Storage module.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required icon library: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Use <Plant size={32} weight='duotone' /> from Phosphor Icons as the app logo instead of an image.
Implement Shadcn UI components for complex interactivity (Select, Dialog, Form, Table).
Ensure the dashboard uses a collapsible left sidebar layout.
For PDF Generation, install and use 'jspdf' and 'jspdf-autotable' or a similar library to satisfy the Invoice PDF download requirement.
Ensure 'Phase 1: everything at once' is reflected in the sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Vendors, Farmers, Companies, Products, Godowns, Purchases, Sales, Stock, Ledger, Invoices, Reports).
Implement a Farmer Ledger view showing a running balance of transactions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific interactive elements.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers, or surfaces over content.
NEVER use emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use 2-3x more spacing (Tailwind p-8 to p-12) in marketing sections. Keep ERP tables dense but readable.
Ensure all buttons have distinct hover/active states.
Always include a data-testid attribute on interactive elements to support automated testing.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment (e.g., adjust padding for icons next to text).
Form inputs must have clear labels, placeholder text, and visible focus states.
Data tables must allow horizontal scrolling on smaller screens without breaking layout.
Use progressive disclosure: hide secondary actions behind an ellipses menu in dense tables.
Error states in forms must clearly indicate the field and reason, not just a red border.
